summary: This item is a very short WORKTECH Academy news notice, effectively only a headline with no substantive body text. There is also no discussion of workplace practice themes such as hybrid work policy, desk booking, occupancy analytics, visitor management, or facilities operations, beyond the implicit context that MillerKnoll is a furniture and workplace design company and WORKTECH Academy is a workplace innovation research platform. For a listening pipeline, the only usable signal is a vendor and industry-body relationship data point: a major furniture manufacturer aligning itself with a workplace research network.
